verdict.rationale: A payments platform could plausibly ship automations with version history, review, and rollback, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence that Stripe versions, reviews, or rolls back user automations. API release versioning, human confirmation of MCP write actions, and the third-party Kyber no-code builder are adjacent features or partner apps, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
